lines.text: The judge refuses for a while, but later decides to give the widow justice because he fears God.
A Pharisee and a priest pray at the temple, and the Pharisee thanks God he is not like others.

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "threatening" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
The line says the judge gives the widow justice, but the verses only say he decides to do so.
